answer: Proof of Burn acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy assets to prove commitment. Like drilling through shale to reach deep reserves, an attacker must sacrifice capital to gain influence. This threshold functions as a summit of economic entry, ensuring that identity creation is not free. By forcing agents to stake value in a digital meadow of competition, the network renders the cost of spinning up multiple fake identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
